start: Joined to a gym that uploaded a logo and colours in Branding; Gym tab

user_sees: The gym's logo, 56 dp high, in its own shape with a thin border
The gym's name next to it in the gym's heading style, up to 2 lines
'Your gym' under the name ('Pay at the desk' when the gym's shop is on)
must_not: The logo squeezed into a circle or cropped
Another gym's logo or name

user_sees: The logo full size on a dark screen
The gym's name under it
A close X at the top right
must_not: The logo cut at the edges
The page behind showing through the logo

steps.action: Tap anywhere (or the X, or the phone's Back)
user_sees: The Gym tab as it was
must_not: The app going back a screen or closing on Back

start: Joined to a gym with only colours set (no logo)

user_sees: A small dot in the gym colour and the gym's name
'Your gym' under it
must_not: An empty grey box where a logo would be
A tap target that opens an empty viewer

user_sees: Nothing opens
must_not: A full-size viewer with no picture

start: Gym logo link broken (file deleted or no internet on first open, nothing cached)

user_sees: The small dot and the gym's name
Nothing to tap
must_not: A broken-picture mark
A tappable box that opens an empty dark screen

start: Gym not branded at all (no logo, no colours)

user_sees: No big header; the gym's name and tagline in the normal screen title
must_not: Both the header and the title showing the name twice
A blank gap at the top

start: The gym changes its logo in Branding while the member has the app open

steps.action: Come back to the app after about an hour (member_me is asked again)
user_sees: The new logo in the header
must_not: The old logo kept for days
Old and new logos mixed between tabs

user_sees: The new logo full size
must_not: The old logo in the full-size viewer from the disk cache

start: Phone switched from gym A to gym B

steps.action: Open the Gym tab right after the switch
user_sees: Gym B's name; gym A's logo is not drawn while the look is still gym A's
must_not: Gym A's logo or name over gym B's tab
